metaDescription: Kianja connects freelance students with clients who need their skills.
title: Kianja links students' skills to clients' needs
intro: A marketplace designed for all students who want to offer their skills as freelancers, and for clients looking for talent.
mission1: Kianja's mission is to make it easier for freelance students and clients, individuals or organizations, who need specific work to meet: development, design, writing, translation, marketing and many other fields.
mission2: The platform is open to all students, regardless of their institution: what matters is their skills.
problem1: Many students have useful skills but few ways to make them known or land their first missions. Clients, for their part, struggle to quickly find reliable profiles for one-off needs.
problem2: Kianja brings missions, services and profiles together in one place and supports the collaboration, from application to delivery.

need.title: A need or a skill
need.detail: A client posts a mission, or a student presents a service they offer.

match.title: A connection
match.detail: Students apply to missions, clients review applications or request a service, and everyone communicates through the platform's messaging.

delivery.title: Work delivered and approved
delivery.detail: The student uploads their deliverables, the client approves them, then the payment is released and each can review the other.

open.title: Opening up opportunities
open.detail: Letting every student make the most of their skills while still studying, whatever their institution.

clear.title: Staying clear
clear.detail: Readable missions, services and profiles, so everyone knows what they offer or expect.

protect.title: Protecting data
protect.detail: Profiles only show information useful for collaboration; private contact details are not displayed.

trust.title: Building trust
trust.detail: Payment held until the delivery is approved, reviews and reports for trustworthy exchanges.

vision: To make Kianja a leading meeting point where students build their professional experience and clients find the skills they need.
ctaText: Browse the publications or create your account to offer your skills or post a need.
